text:
Aisha - CS: FYI — MediTrust just asked to onboard a clinical note summarization model that will see PHI. They want private deployment (VPC/on-prem option) and explicit safety constraints. Can we start intake?
Tom - Eng: Thanks. Quick Qs: model architecture/framework? weights format? expected qps & latency SLO?
Aisha - CS: Vendor sent a 13B T5-style model, PyTorch checkpoint + tokenizer. They want ~200 qps at peak, 95th pctl latency <300ms. Prefer private (customer-managed network) but will consider Dedicated if private blocking.
Lucas - ML: Important: PHI + clinical means we need a strict eval plan: hallucination tests, entity leakage tests, and a redaction verification pass. Also need to know whether vendor allows persistent KV cache or not (PHI risk).
Tom - Eng: Noted. For private deploy: we need their KMS details (customer KMS or bring-your-own-HSM), expected storage for model artifacts, and whether the model uses custom ops that require kernel patches. Any docs from vendor about operator requirements?
Aisha - CS: I have their onboarding packet. They confirmed no custom CUDA kernels but they do recommend int8 quantization for perf. They asked for guidance on acceptable quant configs — customer wants to keep fidelity.
Lucas - ML: We'll run a baseline eval: clinical summarization prompts + red-team prompts for instruction-following. Metrics: clinical factuality (entity-level precision/recall), hallucination rate, PII leakage score, and latency cost curve at batch sizes 1/4/8. Also recommend a small guardrail model for reranking outputs for PHI.
onboard-bot: Intake created: OT-5921. Please fill the intake form: https://redwood.internal/onboard/OT-5921 and attach sample prompt set + 200 anonymized examples (PHI removed).
Aisha - CS: MediTrust is pushing for go-live in 6 weeks if we can meet SOC2+HIPAA checklist. Customer is open to a canary on Dedicated first then full Private.
Tom - Eng: Plan proposal: 1) Security review (KMS, network, retention) — 1 week. 2) ML eval & small red-team — 1.5 weeks. 3) Performance tuning (quant/throughput) on Dedicated test pool — 2 weeks. 4) Private deploy & validation — 1 week. Sounds tight but doable if vendor provides sample data and SRE time.
Lucas - ML: Action items for ML: get vendor tokenizer + sample corpus, generate red-team suite, run entity-level tests. I'll draft eval scripts and share.
Aisha - CS: I'll request the 200 anonymized notes and confirm KMS details. Also looping in legal for BAA.
Tom - Eng: Ping me once the sample data is uploaded to the intake ticket. I can carve out a Dedicated test pool for tuning.
Aisha - CS: Great — scheduling kickoff with MediTrust for tomorrow 10am PT. Will post notes to OT-5921. :thumbsup:
Tom - Eng: :eyes:
Lucas - ML: I'll have an initial eval checklist by EOD Friday.
Aisha - CS: Thanks team. Keeping this thread for async updates.
